servinfo.title: Gasoline Particulate Filter (GPF) Pressure Sensor Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: With ignition “OFF”, disconnect GPF pressure sensor connector (1).
Disconnect GPF pressure sensor hose No.1 (2) and No.2 (3).
Disconnect A/F sensor and HO2S harness from GPF pressure sensor bracket (5), if necessary.
Remove GPF pressure sensor bracket, if necessary.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Fix A/F sensor and HO2S harness with clamps.
Install GPF pressure sensor hose clamps in proper position.
